figures.finding: Guyana has no film commission or film fund yet: in October 2024 the President told Parliament the Ministry of Culture, Youth and Sports was negotiating a co-production agreement that would lead to a national film commission. In May 2026 the government was inviting foreign productions under its orange-economy (creative industries) initiative, which had a G$3.7 billion allocation for 2026, with no film fund, commission or incentive named.

value.status: national film commission announced October 2024, not yet established

sources.said: He said, “The Ministry of Culture, Youth and Sports, is currently negotiating a CO production agreement with one key international partner, an agreement that will precipitate the establishment of a national film commission

Officially introduced in late 2025, the orange economy initiative, which encompasses creative industries, cultural production and entertainment, seeks to boost Guyana’s creative industries. It received a budgetary allocation of $3.7 billion in 2026.
